digest.component_or_area: ticket clarity scoring and plan-review validation
propositions: A hard clarity floor rule must detect only structurally incompatible plan states, never style preferences, and be validated against closed tickets carrying both plan-review and completion attestations.

Acceptance Criteria items must be nonempty after joining continuations and normalizing whitespace; exact duplicates are advisory only, not hard failures, as demonstrated by counterexample 8d27 which legitimately repeated a global test gate.

Bare unresolved sentinels (TBD/TODO/FIXME/???) are hard failures only when they occupy unresolved value positions (start a line, follow `:=/is/remains`) in active execution sections (Approach/Scope/Testing/Acceptance Criteria), outside code fences, with removal assertions suppressed.
File-impact path and reason integrity belongs to write-schema validation, not clarity scoring, and should be enforced at mutation boundary rather than in ticket analysis.

Citation of [rebar:id] prerequisites is valid for provenance and downstream scope decomposition; direct-edge validation applies only when an absent symbol claims prerequisite-created credit, not for ordinary transitive or out-of-scope references.

Two hard additions to clarity (nonempty AC items and sentinel assignment detection with structural exclusions) combine with the existing requirement for at least one standard AC checklist item; all other signals remain advisory.
